protocol: Three alternating dynamic/typed pairs per control, 30 frames/run, 10Hz, two sensors, 20000 retained points each. Single-variable controls use the same run protocol; control blocks run in fixed order on a shared unpinned host. Native processes hold one exclusive timing lock. No measured-packet acknowledgement/retry; 300ms drain. Raw callback records bytes and deserializes after timing. Publish time excludes caller packet construction. CPU is transport-process CPU, not the complete simulator.

precommit_repeat.protocol: Separate precommit repeat with reversed control block order: reliable before baseline, three alternating endpoint pairs each, same 30 frames/10Hz/two sensors/full-rate protocol, ROS domain180.
